Neither guide ties it to a specific save point; keep tapping every available BSS trigger and it can appear on almost any branch instead of the ending you were aiming for. Neither xneo.jp nor mmitsuru marks explicit save points for this branching prologue; this save slot is an editorial addition placed at the earliest safe point so every one of Joukan's 19 endings can be reached and reloaded from a shared checkpoint.
